tool.name: TradingView
tool.description: TradingView is a charting platform for forex, stocks, futures and crypto. Charts, alerts, a screener and paper trading run in the browser, with desktop and mobile apps that keep the same layouts.
features: Charts, drawing tools and a large built-in indicator set, plus community scripts
Price alerts, watchlists and stock, ETF and crypto screeners
Bar replay and strategy testing, with higher limits on paid plans

plans.name: Basic
plans.detail: The free plan on the pricing page.

plans.name: Essential
plans.detail: Annual billing, shown as a special price.

plans.name: Plus
plans.detail: Annual billing. The page says this saves $60 a year.

plans.name: Premium
plans.detail: Annual billing. The page says this saves $120 a year.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.detail: Annual billing. The page says this saves $480 a year.

tool.pricing_note: Annual billing prices shown on the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. Monthly billing is also offered. Extra real-time exchange data is a separate charge.
